decisions.reason: The lever handle family sits within the firm's core coordinated-range strategy and shows no reported shortfall against aspirations, so the firm's slack lets it keep carrying the line while results mature.
The mitred lever family costs little to carry on shared tooling and shows no evidence of underperformance that would trigger problemistic search, so retention remains the default.
This standard lever line uses existing manufacturing and finishing capacity, so with no signal of a shortfall the firm keeps it rather than reallocate resources.
The award-winning FSB 1289 collection with its own page clearly exceeds aspirations and is a flagship worth retaining.
The patinated bronze finish draws on in-house finishing and enhances several handle families at minimal cost, so there is no aspiration gap to justify withdrawing it.
